reason: The repository identifies a user-facing DeepSeek Harness web plugin whose core function is visual customization: creating, editing, previewing, and sharing UI skins with themed color tokens, component and media replacements, and text overrides. This aligns most directly with a themes/layout purpose, with file-based skin package handling and local browser persistence as secondary mechanics.

summaries.zh: dsh-skin-studio 是 DeepSeek Harness 的皮肤工作室插件，用于创建、管理并应用可移植界面皮肤，支持配色、组件与背景素材替换、文案与字体设置及实时预览。
summaries.en: dsh-skin-studio is a DeepSeek Harness skin studio plugin for creating, managing, and applying portable UI skins with color themes, component and background media overrides, text and font customization, and real-time preview.

capabilities: Customizes DeepSeek Harness web interface appearance via theme tokens and slot overlays
Supports importing/exporting portable skin packages with media, fonts, and locale text data
Manages local persistence of skin settings via browser storage and runtime UI preview

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a DeepSeek Harness skin studio for creating/managing multiple skins, editing colors, backgrounds, copy, and fonts.
README describes importing validated .dshskin packages, with schema checks, size limits, and per-resource constraints.
Package metadata declares a web client-side DSH plugin entry with theme/slots-related runtime dependencies, confirming browser runtime operation.
README notes storage is kept per browser origin (local config persistence).
